## Problem

Describe the user or operator problem and who encounters it.

## Proposed outcome

Describe the desired behavior, API shape, policy, or operational workflow.

## Alternatives

Describe current workarounds or alternative designs.

## Compatibility, migration, and security

Call out schema migration, protocol, namespace authorization, identity,
artifact, rollout, downgrade, and secret-handling effects.

## Additional context

Add links, safe examples, or relevant prior art. Do not attach credentials,
private workloads, database dumps, or log content.
